import sys

def dfs(board, word, i, j, index=0):
    if index == len(word):
        return True
    if i < 0 or i >= len(board) or j < 0 or j >= len(board[0]) or board[i][j] != word[index]:
        return False
    temp, board[i][j] = board[i][j], '#'
    found = (dfs(board, word, i + 1, j, index + 1) or
             dfs(board, word, i - 1, j, index + 1) or
             dfs(board， word, i, j + 1, index + 1) or
             dfs(board, word, i, j - 1, index + 1))
    board[i][j] = temp
    return found

def isWordExist(board, word):
    return any(dfs(board, word, i, j) for i in range(len(board)) for j in range(len(board[0])))

def main():
    import sys
    input = sys.stdin.read().strip().split('\n')
    n, m = map(int, input[0].split())
    board = [list(input[i].strip()) for i in range(1, n + 1)]
    word = input[n + 1].strip()
    print(1 if isWordExist(board, word) else 0)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
